traits.zh: 挑高两层空间，裸露混凝土顶与旧木梁
traits.en: Two-story space with exposed concrete and old wooden beams

traits.zh: 天花板装轨道射灯，二层平台底部有暖色灯带
traits.en: Track lights and warm underglow on the second floor

traits.zh: 二层靠窗处可见窗外绿植与建筑轮廓
traits.en: Second-floor windows offer views of greenery and buildings

traits.zh: 一层设不锈钢吧台，二层有白色桌椅组合
traits.en: Stainless steel bar on the first floor, white tables and chairs upstairs

traits.zh: 由旧工业厂房改造，复合艺术空间
traits.en: Converted from an old factory, a mixed art space
